settings.heading: Innovations for life, since 2003
settings.body: For more than 20 years, we've been committed to creating safer workplaces, roads, and communities. The use of alcohol and drugs are significant issues for our society, and our solutions help you make informed decisions. We offer a broad selection of alcohol and drug testing solutions to support the needs of all Australians.

settings.heading: Innovate
settings.body: To add value to our products and services, take on only products that are backed by scientific rigour, and proactively challenge and improve our systems and products.

settings.heading: Nurture
settings.body: To contribute to a happier environment by understanding and supporting others, respecting and valuing ideas, and developing and growing the leader within.

settings.heading: Excellence
settings.body: To commit to bringing trusted and proven products to the market and consistently work to the highest standards. Looking for more efficient ways to do what we do.

settings.heading: First retail experience
settings.body: Selling alcohol testers at Caribbean Market Melbourne and the Andatech booth at Chadstone Shopping Centre.

settings.heading: First AS3547:1997 Certified Breathalyser
settings.body: Became the first Australian company to achieve Australian Standard AS3547:1997 certification for an affordable personal breathalyser under $200.

settings.heading: First expo in Melbourne
settings.body: Andatech exhibits at the Carlton Exhibition Building, with founder Irwandy's mother supporting the stand.

settings.heading: First office and warehouse
settings.body: The growing business moves into its first dedicated office and warehouse.

settings.heading: Safety in Action Expo
settings.body: Andatech exhibits at the Safety in Action Expo in Melbourne, Australia.

settings.heading: Expanded into Vietnam
settings.body: Andatech expands into the Vietnamese market.

settings.heading: TrafficInfraTech Expo
settings.body: Andatech attends the TrafficInfraTech Expo in Mumbai, India.

settings.heading: Caltrace launches
settings.body: Launch of the Caltrace Service Management System.

settings.heading: Australian Standard certification
settings.body: Andatech receives Australian Standard AS3547:2019 certification for workplace breathalysers.

settings.heading: NATA accreditation
settings.body: Andatech's Calibration Centre receives NATA accreditation.

settings.heading: National business recognition
settings.body: Winner at the Australian Business Awards and Whitehorse Business Awards. Ionmax also becomes an approved NDIS provider.

settings.heading: CHOICE recommended
settings.body: The Ionmax Aire air purifier receives a CHOICE recommendation.

settings.heading: ISO 27001 accredited
settings.body: Andatech is officially accredited to ISO/IEC 27001, the internationally recognised standard for information security management systems.

settings.heading: Andatech today
settings.body: More than two decades on, Andatech continues to build safer workplaces from its Melbourne headquarters.

settings.heading: Story of Andatech
settings.description: From a Melbourne garage in 2003 to Australia's leading workplace drug and alcohol testing specialist. Two decades of building safer workplaces, one milestone at a time.
